other_failure_modes.name: Categorical features treated as continuous
other_failure_modes.description: The agent encodes categorical features using an OrdinalEncoder but fails to cast them to a `category` dtype or explicitly pass them as categorical features to the tree-based model (e.g., LightGBM). This causes the model to incorrectly treat unordered categories as continuous numerical variables.

summary: The agent provides a robust baseline solution utilizing LightGBM with 5-fold cross-validation and proper data cleaning practices. However, the model lacks feature engineering, relies entirely on a single evaluation metric (RMSE), and inadvertently treats ordinally encoded categorical variables as continuous numerical features in LightGBM.
